question: What outcome follows from abstaining from food during the day?
premises: Non-eating during the day is specified as the means
The outcome concerns death related to age
The verse states a future result
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by age.
uncertainties: The phrase vayo-mṛtyuṃ may imply natural death rather than premature death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will meet death only through old age.
